findings.statement: Ding Junhui arrived in the wrong trousers for his opening match at the English Open in Brentwood and needed a quick change.
Ding Junhui recovered from being docked a frame to grind out a 4-3 victory over Ma Hailong.
Mark Allen made four consecutive century breaks, the highest 127, as he thrashed Mostafa Dorgham 4-0 in less than an hour.
